entities.summary: Jonathan Kale is a retired American-born Ivorian professional basketball player. Kale was a four-year player for Providence College and started every game in his senior season, averaging a career best 10.1 PPG and 6.0 RPG. He finished in the top 15 on the Providence career list in offensive rebounds and field goal percentage.
